fields.summary: TC-851-01: Audit Fails With Status Failed When Required Flight Fields Are Missing From Trip

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-851

Precondition: A trip exists in DynamoDB with one or more required flight fields missing (e.g., coaTripFirstFltDtm, coaTripLastFltDtm, coaDpFirstFltDtm, coaDpLastFltDtm are null). The audit process must detect this and fail the audit rather than producing incorrect results.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up a trip record in DynamoDB where coaTripFirstFltDtm and coaDpFirstFltDtm are null (missing flight fields)
DynamoDB COA record: tripId present, auditNeeded=true, coaTripFirstFltDtm=null, coaTripLastFltDtm=null, coaDpFirstFltDtm=null, coaDpLastFltDtm=null
Trip record exists in DynamoDB with missing flight time fields and auditNeeded=true
Trigger the Phase 2 audit workflow for the trip (trip release time has passed)
Phase 2 audit triggered: COA_CSS_PHASE_2_TOGGLE=TRUE, COA_CSS_PHASE_2_AUTO_AUDIT_TOGGLE=TRUE, trip release time past
Phase 2 audit workflow is invoked for the trip
Verify the audit Lambda detects the missing flight fields and does not proceed with pay calculation
Audit Lambda validation check for coaTripFirstFltDtm, coaTripLastFltDtm, coaDpFirstFltDtm, coaDpLastFltDtm
Audit Lambda identifies the missing required flight fields and halts processing before any pay calculation
Verify the audit status is updated to Failed in DynamoDB
DynamoDB audit status field after audit processing attempt with missing flight fields
auditStatus = Failed in DynamoDB record - audit is not marked as Completed with potentially incorrect pay data
Verify the COA Search App reflects the Failed audit status and the missing fields are visible for investigation
COA Search App queried for the trip after failed audit
COA Search App shows auditStatus=Failed and the missing flight time fields are identifiable for the trip
